nodes.subtreeText: A scrambled version 13, 3, 2, 21, 1, 1, 8, 5 (OEIS A117540 ) of the first eight Fibonacci numbers appear as one of the clues left by murdered museum curator Jacque Saunière in D. Brown's novel The Da Vinci Code (Brown 2003, pp. 43, 60-61, and 189-192). In the Season 1 episode " Sabotage " (2005) of the television crime drama NUMB3RS , math genius Charlie Eppes mentions that the Fibonacci numbers are found in the structure of crystals and the spiral of galaxies and a nautilus shell.
